title: English scanned invoice final native-table visual review
scope: All five final output PNG pages compared with their five previously inspected source PNG pages; four fixed synthetic English cases only.
reviewMethod: Agent visual inspection through view_image. This is not human sign-off or pixel-difference scoring. Native editability and exact cell values are established separately by final-report.json XML checks.
nonblockingDifferences: Output uses smaller regular-weight headings and regular-weight table headers instead of the source bold styling.
Output row heights, rule weight, paragraph spacing and margins differ from the source; content remains readable with no clipping or overlap.
Wrapped-description line-break locations differ while both complete descriptions remain inside their own cells.
The borderless memo's tab-aligned amount column becomes inline paragraph text; the required ordered content and zero-table result are retained. Exact tab positioning was not part of this gate.

findings: One visible four-column table contains the header and all three item rows with clear separating rules.
00421 stays with Analysis package, quantity 2 and 240.50; 00632 stays with Review service, quantity 3 and 135.30; 00874 stays with Archive support, quantity 1 and 19.95.
Invoice header, customer paragraph, pre-table paragraph, 395.75 total and final paragraph are readable once in source order.
No text clipping, table overflow, overlapping cells, duplicated page image or spurious extra page is visible.
Both long descriptions occupy two lines inside their respective description cells, and horizontal rules enclose each complete item row.
00542 and the complete research-team description stay with quantity 2 and 280.50; 00763 and the complete project description stay with quantity 3 and 165.30.
The 00985 Archive support row retains quantity 1 and 29.95; the 475.75 total and complete final paragraph remain below the table.
No continuation line crosses into the next item row or follows a numeric amount outside the table. No clipping or overlap is visible.
The first invoice appears on a portrait page with one complete header-plus-three-row table.
00124, 00345 and 00567 remain visibly associated with their own descriptions, quantities and amounts; total 385.75 is below the table.
The full first-page closing paragraph remains on page one. No clipping, spillover or content from invoice two is visible.
The second invoice remains on a separate landscape page and its four-column table fits within the page width.
00235, 00456 and 00678 remain visibly associated with their own descriptions, quantities and amounts; total 515.75 is below the table.
The final paragraph of the second invoice and whole document is fully visible. No clipping, duplicate first-page content or extra page is visible.
No visible table or ruling is invented; references and amounts remain three readable lines of prose.
006731 stays with 81.25, 008952 with 42.60 and 003174 with 19.95, in source order.
Heading, explanatory paragraph and complete final paragraph are visible once with no clipping or overlap.

limitations: This review establishes the scoped readability, wrapping, association and completeness checks for the inspected generated artifacts only.
It does not claim exact source typography, pixel-identical layout, arbitrary borderless-table reconstruction, merged-cell support or multiple tables on one page.
Page dimensions and native cell editability are supported by independent automated checks in the referenced final report rather than inferred from image appearance alone.
